sources_tried: Seed file research/installers/raw/seeds/tacoma.json: worked. Its maps results gave NWBLDS, Building Specialties NW and Wind NW; the rest were remodelers, supply stores, plumbers and a large set of templated 'X Bathroom Remodeling' sites. Western Partitions Inc. (Sumner) checked: drywall/framing subcontractor headquartered in Portland, OR, with no toilet partitions on its site, so excluded.
Bobrick find-a-rep (bobrick.com/find-a-rep): page loads but rep listings are dynamic and none came through. Bobrick Vashon Island HS case study PDF worked (named Wind NW and Barclay Dean).
Scranton Products UW Madrona Hall case study: worked (named Barclay Dean).
ASI, Bradley, Metpar, Ampco/Ammco locators: not tried (ran out of time and budget after the JS and 404 failures).
The Blue Book (thebluebook.com iProView pages for N.W. Building Specialties, Partition Plus, company 259104): blocked, 403.
BuildingConnected / Procore public profiles: not tried.
DJC Specialty Contractor Guide PDF (djc.com/co/scg.pdf): read, but it lists no Division 10 firms.
BBB partitions category (Granite Falls WA): worked; listed only Ironwood Manufacturing (manufacturer, excluded) and Building Specialties NW.

WebSearch: used all 8 allowed. Results were dominated by national online sellers (One Point Partitions, Southwest Solutions Group, Newton Distributing) with no local base; those were excluded and onepointpartitions.com returned 403.
Cook & Boardman JDS / cbxsolutions.com Everett branch: 403. Barclay Dean website: 503. Scott and Company (odoo): 404. CS Installers and Inter-Co: checked, no Washington base, excluded.

candidates.name: Barclay Dean Architectural Products
candidates.partition_evidence: Bobrick case study (Vashon Island High School, WA) names Barclay Dean (Woodinville, WA) as the installing distributor for Bobrick DuraLineSeries partitions.
red_flags: Company website returned HTTP 503 on two tries, so contact details and current service area weren't confirmed
Base city given as Woodinville (2019 case study) and Bothell elsewhere; about 45 miles from Tacoma
candidates.reason: A manufacturer case study confirms it installs commercial partitions in the Puget Sound area (Vashon Island, near Tacoma). Its own site was down, so its contact details and stated service area are unverified.

license.name: Barclay Dean Architectural Products
license.registry: Washington L&I contractor registration (data.wa.gov m8qx-ubtq); City of Tacoma Tax & License business account dataset
license.note: The L&I record is BARCLAY DEAN ARCHTL PRDTS LLC, UBI 601840789, ACTIVE, effective 1998-01-05, expires 2028-01-03. The record city is Bothell, not Woodinville as listed. candidates.name: NW Blds (NWBLDS)
candidates.partition_evidence: Homepage describes a commercial restroom partition company that installs, replaces, repairs and supplies commercial toilet partitions; service-area page has a Tacoma/Pierce County page.
red_flags: Footer mailto points to a different address (kai@nwblds.com) than the listed contact@ address
candidates.reason: Kent-based family-owned commercial partition installer that lists Tacoma, Seattle and Bellevue in its service area. It also sells partitions, so the listing agreement and hidden customer details matter.

candidates.name: Building Specialties Northwest LLC
candidates.partition_evidence: Distributor with a Toilet Partitions & Shower Enclosures category and a 'We Install!' banner linking to its portfolio. The portfolio lists Puget Sound job sites (e.g., IKEA Renton, Thurston County Readiness Center) but doesn't tie partitions or installation to any project.
red_flags: Mainly a distributor that ships nationwide (buy-around risk)
candidates.reason: A Puget Sound Division 10 distributor that supplies partitions and says it installs, but no partition installation project was shown.

license.name: Building Specialties Northwest LLC
license.registry: Washington L&I contractor registration (data.wa.gov m8qx-ubtq); City of Tacoma Tax & License business account dataset
license.note: The L&I record is BUILDING SPECIALTIES NW LLC, UBI 602118871, Mercer Island, ACTIVE, expires 2027-03-03. The legal name "Building Specialties NW" in Mercer Island comes from the lockedmail.com site's own schema markup. The company does not appear in the City of Tacoma Tax & License business account dataset (searched for BUILDING SPECIALT on 2026-11-19; the only hit was ABC Supply's trade name), so no Tacoma business license was found online. Confirm with Tacoma Tax & License (253-591-5252) before a Tacoma job.

candidates.partition_evidence: Calls itself a 'Specialty Commercial Subcontractor & Distributor' with 'the most complete line of bathroom partitions in the Northwest' and offers partition service and repairs. No page read states that it installs partitions.
candidates.reason: A Pacific Northwest commercial Division 10 subcontractor and distributor (WA, OR and ID licenses listed) that carries and services partitions. Partition installation isn't stated outright.
